text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not applicable; the provided otoscopy result ("molar teeth") is an error unrelated to the ear, and the audiogram showing improvement rules out conductive hearing loss or graft failure as the cause of your shooting pain. Given the post-tympanoplasty history, I suspect a neuroma or nerve irritation. Can you describe if the pain shoots to your jaw or temple, and does chewing trigger it?
